I am a Ph.D. student at Shanghai Jiao Tong University (SJTU), advised by Prof. Yanmin Qian in the AudioCC Lab. I work on speech large language models and end-to-end simultaneous speech translation (SimulST / S2ST). The question I keep coming back to is how a speech LLM should decide when to listen and when to speak on an unbounded audio stream, with a quality–latency trade-off that can actually be measured. My recent work approaches this with fine-grained streaming read/write policies learned via reinforcement learning (actor-critic self-enhancement, GRPO post-training with LLM-judge rewards), and I am now extending it toward proactive, full-duplex real-time interaction.
I have published first-author papers at NeurIPS 2023, 2024, 2025 and 2026 on speech translation. Beyond papers, I care about systems that run: our end-to-end Chinese–English simultaneous interpretation system outperforms commercial real-time translation APIs under a unified evaluation protocol, and the on-device multilingual translation model I worked on at Honor shipped with the Magic V5 (MagicSpeech). I am currently a research intern on the Qwen team at Alibaba, and previously interned at Microsoft Research Asia and Honor.
